channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Cloudflare Launches Persistent, Stateful, Computer-Like Environments for Agents
item.description: Cloudflare has introduced Cloudflare Computer, a new open-source runtime designed to give AI agents something closer to a real "computer" instead of just ephemeral containers. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon EC2 R8i and R8i-Flex instances are now available in Europe (Milan) region
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) R8i and R8i-flex instances are available in the Europe (Milan) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now supports backup and restore
item.description: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now lets you create and manage your own backups and restore your data on demand. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Cognito now available as a skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS
item.description: Amazon Cognito is now available as a core skill (aws-auth) in the Agent Toolkit for AWS . (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS IAM Identity Center supports one-click multi-Region option for new organization instances
item.description: AWS IAM Identity Center now makes it easier to enable multi-Region support when creating a new organization instance. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon VPC IPAM now supports BGP route protection monitoring and delegated RPKI for BYOIP prefixes
item.description: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) IP Address Manager (IPAM) now supports BGP route protection monitoring and delegated Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) management for Bring Your Own IP (BYOIP) prefixes. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore adds memory, policy, and harness in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
item.description: Today, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore introduces new capabilities in AWS GovCloud (US-West). AgentCore is the platform to build, connect, and optimize agents. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Google Releases Angular v22 with Stable Signal Forms, OnPush by Default and Experimental WebMCP
item.description: Angular v22, Google's TypeScript-first framework, has introduced API stabilizations, ergonomic templates, and tooling enhancements for AI integration. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: JDK 28 EA Build10 is now available for download and includes JEP 401: Value Objects (Preview) from Project Valhalla

item.title: U.S. Department of Energy Launches the Genesis Open Models Initiative
ICE will release body cam video only when seen in the agency's 'best interests'
item.description: Immigration and Customs Enforcement is moving to equip officers with body cameras in the next two months but the public should not expect to quickly see footage of every critical incident. (1 source: hackernews)
